test_opcheck: test an operator with sample inputs to validate schema, autograd, faketensor, and aot dispatch
generate_opcheck_tests: generate opcheck tests from an existing unittest TestCase for custom operator validation
create_FailuresDict: create a failures dict to track expected test failures for autogenerated opcheck tests
test_FailuresDict_load: load a failures dict from a JSON file to read expected skip and xfail statuses
test_FailuresDict_set_status: set or update the status of a specific test failure in the failures dict
